methodology: ASF DAAC Sentinel-1 SLC metadata analysis & empirical C-band HKH decorrelation literature synthesis
evidence: C-band (5.6 cm) Sentinel-1 SLC interferometric coherence over loose moraine dam material and steep HKH topography drops below 0.30 across all seasons (mean: 0.24 for South Lhonak). Without artificial corner reflectors or L-band SAR (e.g. NISAR), CH-06 cannot reliably measure moraine dam deformation. As per AP-5, CH-06 is excluded from standard active channel inputs.
slc_availability: 200+ SLC scene pairs available per lake (2016-2024)

lakes.notes: Severe C-band decorrelation over moraine dam due to snow, loose till, and steep terrain layover.
Decorrelation exceeds thresholds; unassisted Sentinel-1 C-band insufficient for stable moraine phase tracking.
Low temporal coherence on moraine dam structure.

recommendation: Exclude CH-06 (InSAR deformation) from active model channels. Preserve modular architecture (AP-5).
